scenario: [LGRA.5.8.6]: a `Json` value holding exactly the string-bytes limit, 16,384 UTF-8 bytes, is admitted when the host asserts it into a `Json` slot. The value is one JSON string of 16,384 ASCII `a`s, written with the harness's `$repeat` form so its size is stated rather than typed. The fact lands (fact_count 1). Paired with LGRA.5.8.6_host_string_bytes_over_limit, one byte longer and refused, so a limit of 16,383 (this vector goes red) or 16,385 (the other goes red) is caught. PATH PINNED: on libds, `ds_json_new_string` as pyds's `pyds_py_to_json_tree_at` calls it; on the Mercury runtime, `ds.engine.host_assert` through `ds.fact`'s `sr_json_limit` check (`ds.json.limit_breach`).
